description: Build a GridKit theme: start from a preset, tune every token on a live grid in light and dark, and download one CSS file for Tailwind or plain CSS.
title: Theme builder
intro: Start from a preset and tune the grid's tokens on a live preview, in light and dark. What you download is one small CSS file of overrides, loaded after the theme's stylesheet.

presets.heading: Preset
presets.replace: Replace your changes with {preset}? They are kept only in this page's address.

palette.heading: Palette from one accent
palette.intro: Pick an accent to get the accent, selection and hover colours for both palettes. Each keeps its default lightness, so text on it stays readable.

output.heading: Theme file
output.intro: The tokens you changed, as one stylesheet that works on top of either theme package. The preview above is this file, applied to the page.

contrast.pass: Every contrast check passes at {level}, in both palettes.
contrast.fail: {count, plural, one {# contrast check falls} other {# contrast checks fall}} short of {level}:

import.label: Theme file to import
import.hint: Paste a theme file, such as one downloaded here or a preset. Only the tokens it sets on :root are read.
import.invalid: This isn't a stylesheet the builder can read. Check that every block and comment it opens is closed.
import.replace: Replace your changes with this theme file? They are kept only in this page's address.
import.ignored: Theme loaded. Left out {count, plural, one {# declaration} other {# declarations}} that set no token or can't be applied: {names}.

steps.heading: Use it
steps.import: Save {file} beside your CSS entry, and import it after the theme's stylesheet.
